svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1328 commits across five public projects, 69 active days, peak 126 commits per day. 2026-09-03 through 2026-11-25 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-25T22:50:11.235Z.
